name: WorkIndex
note: general word: test menu cursor line, hardware-test step (HwTestStepTable), 300-frame count set at $C11202

name: WorkIndexNew
note: test mode: new cursor line before TestMenuDrawCursor

name: FrameWaitFlag
note: set by WaitFrame, cleared by SystemInt1 (VBlank) after MessOut and SystemIo

name: BIOS_SYSTEM_MODE_LO
note: low byte of BIOS_SYSTEM_MODE, index of SystemModeTable

name: VBlankCount
note: byte incremented by SystemInt1 on every VBlank; PowerOnTest counts frames between calendar pulses with it

name: Int1CountOnly
note: when non-zero SystemInt1 only increments VBlankCount (set during the calendar test)

name: FrameCounter
note: long incremented by every SystemIo call

name: SelectTimerFrames
note: 60-frame divider of BIOS_SELECT_TIMER in CheckPlayerStart (reloaded with $3B)

name: Credits
note: BCD credit count in backup RAM: CreditCheck subtracts from it with SBCD, SystemMode2 and CheckPlayerStart test it

name: CurrentSlot
note: backup RAM: slot number written by SwitchSlot together with REG_SLOT; SystemMode2 prints it as SLOT n

name: SlotTable
note: backup RAM: 4 bytes per slot, scanned by SelectSlot

name: BiosWorkRam
note: start of the BIOS work RAM, loaded into a5 (A5_BASE) by every BIOS entry

name: WorkRamStart
note: first byte of the 68000 work RAM ($100000-$10FFFF, game area below BiosWorkRam); the card utility points BIOS_CRDPTR here as its card data buffer ($4000 bytes for CARD 2); ChecksumLoop writes its result byte here; start address of the work RAM tests
